name: Ramón Rojo
source:
Picked by Lucifer himself, Ramón was chosen to be Limbo's escort.

With his charismatic personality, he's made it so the majority of first arrived Limbo humans choose Hell over Utopia.

He's even offering to help you find out the secret to yourself... but what if you discover [i]his[/i] first?
